profile.headline: SRE at H-E-B
profile.summary: MERN Full-stack web developer with a desire to work in Development, Instructional Design, or Data Visualization. Former Science Teacher. Skilled in Lesson Planning, Educational Technology, Tutoring, Management, and Curriculum Development.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Debugging

positions.title: Coding Bootcamp
positions.description: Intensive 24-week boot camp. Learned to design and quickly build web applications. Utilized MERN Full-Stack Web Development skills such as: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery,  Firebase, JSON, Node Js, Express, MySQL, MongoDB, and React Js.

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Teacher: 8th grade Science and Gateway (engineering)
positions.description:
The 8th grade science class that I taught used the Argument Driven Inquiry and Engineering course materials developed by the Education Department at UT. Students engaged in hands-on activities to explore key concepts. Their projects required them to perform data collection, build prototypes, and connect the core science concepts to their work through a written essay.

I also taught an Engineering elective (Gateway), using the nationally recognized Project Lead The Way curriculum.

positions.title: Admissions Counselor I
positions.description: Responsible for handling front office reception and administrative duties, which include greeting walk-ins, answering phones, processing transcripts, keeping track of staff schedules, and sorting and distributing mail.

positions.title: Teacher- 9th grade Biology and Wrestling Coach
positions.description:
Teaching: Taught rigorous science curriculum. Course included weekly readings, quizzes, lecture, and lab activities with data analysis and full lab write-up, in addition to research papers. Course focus was on applied math and writing skills in the biological sciences.

Coaching: Brought in experts to teach clinics and enrich after school practices. Created a team website to improve communication of information to players and parents. Used a video camcorder to record matches over the course of the season to use as an instructional tool for incoming and returning wrestlers. Supported the booster club in fundraising efforts.

company.name: Austin Independent School District- LASA HS

positions.title: Aquatics Seasonal Supervisor--Walnut Creek District
positions.description: Supervised a staff of approximately 80 lifeguards at four public pools in the Walnut Creek district of north Austin. Responsibilities included interviewing and supporting managers and head lifeguards, inspecting facilities on a regular basis, identifying and terminating irresponsible employees. In all capacities with the city I have ensured patron safety, enforced rules, communicated with patrons clearly and professionally, maintained appearance of the facility, and attended/directed in-service training regularly. Certifications: Lifeguard Instructor, CPR, First-Aid, Water Rescue, Oxygen Delivery, AED and SCUBA.

positions.title: Lifeguard, Manager and Head Lifeguard
positions.description: Supervise the pool, decks and adjacent areas, watch swimmers, protect their safety, watch for unsafe conditions/ behaviors, make sure rules are followed, give first aid, and, if required, use rescue techniques as prescribed by the American Red Cross. Also keep records in regards to first-aid and incidents, write reports, and do required pool maintenance. I have experience supervising employees as a head lifeguard at Balcones and as a Manager at Deep Eddy. I also have cash handling experience.

positions.title: Server Assistant/Hostess/Receptionist
positions.description: As a server assistant I would deliver excellent customer service at the table by refilling water, bringing food to the table, answering questions, clearing the table, and cleaning and setting tables for new parties. As a lead hostess I would greet guests as they entered the restaurant and decide where to seat them. I would estimate the rate of turnover and do my best to ensure that each server received approximately the same number of guests. I would also assign breaks and closing duties to the other two hostesses. As a receptionist I answered the phone in the office, took reservations, gave directions to the restaurant, and answered questions pertaining to the menu. I would do miscellaneous tasks for the manager including photo copying, filing, emailing, and faxing.

positions.title: Semester Abroad (Student/Volunteer)
positions.description: I studied forest ecology, sustainability, Hindi, and participated in volunteer activities with the Central Himalayan Rural Action Group (Chirag). I was introduced to all of Chirag’s projects, which range from women's health and education to farming practices, composting procedures, water conservation, sanitation, livestock health, and exploring alternative energy sources such as bio-gas that can be used in clean burning stoves as opposed to using wood. Chirag also worked with locals to create sources of revenue. As an income generation project, Chirag was interested in training local teenagers to take tourists on a bird watching/ wildlife tour.  I did the preliminary work to help start this program by choosing a nature trail that demonstrated diversity in forest type and, as a result, diversity in wildlife. I drew a map of the trail and wrote a report.  In my report I detailed the habits of different species of birds, where they were most likely to be seen, and compiled data as to where I saw a particular bird along the trail. The report I submitted will be used to train guides.

positions.title: Cannery Processor
positions.description: I worked as part of a team in the freezer department to complete orders. I learned a wide range of packaging procedures, followed appropriate quality assurance guidelines and contributed to a positive working environment.  I also interacted helpfully with coworkers of foreign nationalities.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant--Murry Lab
positions.description: In the lab I was responsible for daily maintenance of equipment and inventory, preparation of reagents and buffers, as well as keeping detailed records, writing protocols, and entering data into a spreadsheet. I managed a mouse colony—which involved breeding, weaning, and genotyping mice. I kept track of the results using a spreadsheet format I created in Excel. I also assisted with surgeries by administering anesthesia, shaving the chest of the mouse or rat, and then providing the animal with an injection of saline after surgery. I also have experience growing R1 mouse cells, preparing media, changing media, and collecting cells for experiments. I gained familiarity with molecular biology lab techniques such as PCR (polymerase chain reaction), preparation of DNA for sequencing, gel electrophoresis, and immunohistochemical staining. I have experience preparing polysome fractions from mRNA. These samples were then diluted and spectroscopic analysis performed to determine the presence of transcripts. Finally I used TaqMan probes to run assays on the samples. Although I was involved in generating data for this specific post-doctoral research project I did not design the experiments, or analyze the data. I was also involved in some literature research and proof reading of papers submitted for grants.

positions.title: Courtesy Clerk
positions.description: I performed excellent customer service, bagged groceries, offered to help people to their car, and I brought shopping carts inside from the parking lot in all types of weather conditions.  I helped maintain the safety and appearance of the store.

positions.title: Lifeguard
positions.description: Supervise the pool, decks and adjacent areas, watch swimmers, protect their safety, watch for unsafe conditions/ behaviors, make sure rules are followed, give first aid, and, if required, use rescue techniques as prescribed by the American Red Cross. Also keep records in regards to first-aid and incidents, write reports, and do required pool maintenance. I have experience supervising employees as a head lifeguard at Balcones and as a Manager at Deep Eddy. I also have cash handling experience. In the summer of 2002 I taught the Guard Start program at Northwest Pool.

positions.title: Student Internship
positions.description: I assisted the veterinarians and the technicians with surgeries.  I monitored the conditions of animals after surgery and helped groom the animals when necessary.  I also helped with sterilization of tools and surfaces.  I cleaned cages, played with dogs, and interacted with customers professionally.
